== Description ==

A Players Committee deck box at a table, with [[Logan Pietig]] (seated, Seattle jersey) and standing spectators [[Sam Tashima]] (left, red pullover and glasses) and [[Mark Billings]] (centre-left, black sunset T-shirt and glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
